question: Does a retained numerical method enable a checked distinct successor and reduce total participant CPU against competent conventional alternatives?
candidate: Frozen native sparse-factor byproduct retention plus cost-screened Woodbury construction; no arbitrary generated code or model calls
forecast: Development-only CALIBRATION.json; 1.20*(update construction + (fresh+1)*update use) < native construction + (fresh+1)*native use. This is provisional kernel screening, NOT product admission. Rebuilt/equivalent arms construct for causal ablation even if forecast fails.
strong_alternatives: Native COLAMD SuperLU factors with conventional retention/refactorization; warm-start Jacobi CG with cached matrix; equally enabled identical conventional reuse. No fastest-held-out oracle. DirectCG is the no-retained-factor mechanism contrast, not the strongest reuse baseline.
mission_sequence: A useful native solve yields factors as byproduct; 8 fresh B loads; C chooses rank-k positive edge changes from actual accepted B08 largest absolute flows and returns changed-network response; 2 or 12 fresh D loads; changed grounding invokes specialist; negative conductance refuses. All task/output checks use the independent edge checker.
correctness: Positive finite conductances, grounding>=0.1; edge-balance relative infinity residual<=1e-9 AND normalized energy identity error<=1e-9; finite results; exact source/input/operator/receipt bindings.
qualified_denominator: 11+fresh per stream, including A,8B,C,D,SHIFT. Unsupported request assessed separately as correct refusal. Unattempted outputs after a fault remain unqualified; no deletion of failed streams.
budget_origin: Earned starts at zero. Transfer only bounded unused service reservation after accepted B; capped by remaining service endowment and cap. All arms receive identical transfer opportunity except no-reinvestment. Transfers conserve externally supplied quota, are not cash, and do not establish incremental savings. Research construction debits actual dispatched CPU. Shared startup, custody settlement and aggregate artifacts use separately measured external control allowance.
budget_enforcement: Reservations prevent borrowing across accounts. Actual indivisible native overrun is charged and held, not physically preempted. Whole-control budget violation blocks product admission. Expiry/deadline/STOP checked by custody. Native recurrence is a finite foreground recipe through original workbench, not an installed daemon.
primary: Ratio of mean whole-participant CPU, flywheel/native_refactor, over 24 paired independent streams. Meaningful benefit requires upper two-sided95% stratified paired bootstrap CI <0.95 and all offered flywheel outcomes qualified, with no budget violation/failure.
competitive_guard: Conventional reuse has identical information, tools and cost-screening. Noninferiority requires upper95% ratio flywheel/conventional_reuse <1.10; all matched comparator outputs qualified. No superiority claim from equivalence or mechanism labels.
product_admission: Both primary and competitive guard, all scope/recovery checks, zero trial failures/budget violations. Otherwise HOLD. Correctness-qualified provisional research use does not imply product acceptance.
secondary: Construction CPU, accepted fresh parent-using outcomes, total latency/throughput, storage, per-phase costs, comparisons to rebuilt/equivalent/direct/no-reinvestment, regime crossover, credit actually debited. Descriptive intervals only; no additional confirmatory superiority claims.

uncertainty.paired_across: same seed and same generated inputs
uncertainty.ratio: ratio of arithmetic means; resample six streams with replacement within each of four regimes

freshness: Generate 24 unique 32-bit network seeds from secrets after freeze is durably saved and announced in issue4850. Reject development seeds. Fixed RNG seeds for arm order and bootstrap only. No fresh result access before this freeze.
repeated_testing: One confirmatory campaign only. No rerun, optional stopping, exclusion, tuning or source repair after outcomes are seen. Failures recorded and remaining trials continue under same source.
development_limit: Three full campaign attempts. Third stopped at maintenance overrun; its bounded remainder also stopped. Both preserved. Final engineering fixes and component tests do not add a new candidate family or fourth efficacy campaign.
costs: Whole-participant CPU includes Python stream setup, matrix assembly, hashing, checking, persistence, actual workbench child CPU, failed actions, maintenance and raw evidence writing; imports/corpus review/development/independent audit are separately measured research overhead where observable. Human/LLM fees/time and full monetary investment unknown. Saved CPU not converted to money.

claim_ladder.reuse: actual retained solve on changed RHS plus independent validity
claim_ladder.construction: parent invoked constructing distinct changed-operator method, accepted predecessor bound, fresh D valid with actual parent call
claim_ladder.full_investment_recovery: requires all attributable research/human costs, currently unknown
claim_ladder.acceleration: increasing improvement rate under comparable conditions; not tested by this finite one-successor study

protection: Fixed candidate vocabulary, immutable source manifest, evaluation/calibration/authority data supplied by fixed driver; no candidate write capability. Same-host files are integrity-bound, not independently administered secure enclaves. Separate checker implementation is same team/host, not institutional replication.
exclusions: None for attempted trials. Unsupported task is prospectively outside qualified denominator and must be explicitly refused. No external network, account, wallet, credential, transaction or production action.
interventions: One experiment launch; no manual per-phase task selection. Development setup, source fixes, recovery probes, review, packaging and approval work are separately logged and not claimed autonomous. Unknown durations are not zero.
